bugs.error_message: TypeError: Invalid URL at new URL(SITE_URL) in layout
bugs.root_cause: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL= empty in .env; `??` keeps empty string
Tailwind v4 max-w-* also reads --spacing-*; --spacing-wrap (template) won over --container-wrap

bugs.error_message: next build: Error occurred prerendering page /sitemap.xml (Dataset not found)
bugs.root_cause: sitemap used client.fetch (throws) and only listed CMS pages
bugs.fix: safeFetch + static Advertisr routes, CMS pages that collide with static paths skipped

bugs.error_message: Parsing CSS source code failed: Unexpected token BadUrl(data:image/svg+xml…)
bugs.root_cause: Arbitrary bg-[url("data:…")] class produced invalid CSS; stale in dev cache after removal
bugs.fix: Replaced with inline <svg> Tick; cleared .next/dev; added @source not "../../design"

bugs.error_message: Error parsing: app/package.json (tsx/next fail to start)
bugs.root_cause: Regex removal of scripts left a trailing comma after the last script
bugs.fix: Removed the comma; validate with node -e require

bugs.error_message: Property '_id' does not exist on type '({ _key } & CaseStudyReference) | {...}'
bugs.root_cause: Typegen can't narrow `_type in [...] => {}` conditional projections, so resolved and unresolved shapes unioned
bugs.fix: One conditional per block type (caseCards, caseList) sharing a projection string

bugs.root_cause: Nav set CTA href from a DOM lookup inside useEffect
bugs.fix: href=/groeiplan + onClick that scrolls to #groeiplan when the page has it

bugs.root_cause: Python str.replace replaced every occurrence when adapting the test to the removed SITE_DEFAULTS
bugs.fix: Restored addressCountry in the CMS-merged expectation

bugs.error_message: npm ci EUSAGE: Missing @emnapi/core@2.0.0-beta.2 / @emnapi/runtime from lock file (Deploy Sanity Studio action)
bugs.root_cause: Lockfile written by npm 11 (local Node 24) omits deps of optional @rolldown/binding-wasm32-wasi; npm 10 (Node 22 on CI) treats that as out of sync. Regenerating the lockfile doesn't help. Node 24 on CI ships npm 12, which also rejects it; pinning Node only moved the problem.
bugs.fix: Regenerated studio/package-lock.json with `npx npm@12 install --package-lock-only` in a clean copy: adds node_modules/@emnapi/core + runtime. Verified `npm ci --dry-run` passes on npm 10, 11 and 12 in a dir without node_modules. | 2026-11-11 app/Dockerfile (Build App Image): npm@12 lock regen fails there ('Fetching packages of type remote have been disabled' on @tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi), so instead the deps stage runs `npm install -g npm@11.6.2 && npm ci` — same npm as local, verified clean `npm ci --dry-run` on 11.6.2.

bugs.error_message: Kennisbank search and category pills don't filter; always all articles
bugs.root_cause: Search input and Pills were visual-only placeholders (ponytail comment in ArticleIndex). First fix unmounted empty sections, and remounted .rv elements stayed opacity 0 because SiteEffects observes .rv once per pathname.
bugs.fix: ArticleFilter context (q + category) in kennisbank.tsx; FilterItem/FilterGroup/FilterEmpty hide via className 'contents'/'hidden', never unmount. New articleIndex.noResults field.

bugs.error_message: Empty Docker build-arg (unset GitHub variable) bakes NEXT_PUBLIC_X="" into the bundle; `?? default` doesn't fall back, so dataset/apiVersion become '' and Sentry sample rate Number('')=0
bugs.root_cause: `ARG X` + `ENV X=$X` always defines the var, empty when not passed; `??` only catches undefined
bugs.fix: Use `||` for env fallbacks of NEXT_PUBLIC_SANITY_DATASET, NEXT_PUBLIC_SANITY_API_VERSION, NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE

bugs.error_message: All form things are lost from Sanity (form builder, Form settings); forms were hard-coded
bugs.root_cause: 87de3f7 removed the template form builder and replaced it with a fixed-field LeadForm + /api/lead and env-only mail settings
bugs.fix: Restored form/formField/formGeneralSettings schemas, MailTest panel, /api/submit-form, /api/test-mail, captcha, FormRenderer (restyled); blocks reference form docs; migrated dataset (5 forms)

bugs.error_message: git show "$R:app/..." fails: unknown revision '87de3f7^pp/...' / curl $args sends one argument
bugs.root_cause: zsh treats $VAR:a / :s / :h etc. as history modifiers and does not word-split unquoted $args
bugs.fix: Use ${R}:path and run word-split loops under bash -c

bugs.error_message: Service page not the same as the design on mobile
bugs.root_cause: FAQ summary used text-lg (28px line-height) instead of body 1.65; Stage's max-mob:min-h-0 overrode the Meta phone stage's max-sm:min-h-130 below 520px (design keeps 520px)
bugs.fix: text-lg/[1.65] on FAQ summary; max-mob:min-h-130! on the phone stage (cn has no tailwind-merge)

bugs.error_message: Mobile page looks right on refresh, then flips to a stretched desktop-like layout
bugs.root_cause: Closed mobile drawer is position:fixed translated off-screen right (x 375-698); body overflow-x:hidden doesn't clip fixed elements, so real mobile browsers widen the layout viewport and zoom out. Chrome emulation doesn't show it.
bugs.fix: Wrap drawer in a pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 overflow-hidden layer and make the drawer absolute inside it

bugs.error_message: Mobile: after load the 'Wat wij doen' photo covers the whole ledger (looks stretched/desktop)
bugs.root_cause: Deliverables photo box used max-dsk:static (ported from design's position:static). Its next/image `fill` child is position:absolute, so with a static box it filled the nearest positioned ancestor (the whole grid). Only visible once the lazy image loaded, hence the 'flip'.
bugs.fix: max-dsk:relative max-dsk:top-0 (relative keeps it the containing block; top-0 cancels the sticky top-[104px] offset)

bugs.error_message: Homepage 'Vier schakels' cards differ from design: n8n badge wraps under 'AI Agent Workflows', cards 25px taller
bugs.root_cause: next/font Inter subsets (even latin-ext) have no U+2192; the CSS '→' falls back to a ~16px glyph vs 13.7px in the design, leaving the label 0.8px short so the badge wrapped. Band also inherited text-base's 1.5 line-height.
bugs.fix: after:w-[.92em] after:shrink-0 on the link arrow; text-base/[1.65] on the band

bugs.error_message: Sanity images low quality on site, served as webp while original is jpeg
bugs.root_cause: Image wrapper using sanityLoader was deleted in 87de3f7; components imported next/image directly so /_next/image re-compressed fixed-size Sanity URLs at q=75
bugs.fix: Restored components/ui/Image.tsx (client wrapper applying sanityLoader for cdn.sanity.io srcs) and pointed all next/image imports to it
